92489-accept.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

95772-accept.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-accept.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772-accept.title: Songblade Search
